title: Installed applications (this user)
whyItMatters: Launchers a person adds for themselves show the apps they installed without the package manager, and often the work or hobby they set up the machine for.
source: freedesktop.org Desktop Entry spec: per-user entries go in $XDG_DATA_HOME/applications: https://specifications.freedesktop.org/desktop-entry-spec/latest/
notes: Names only. AppImage helpers, Electron installers and manual .desktop files land here; an entry with the same name as a system one overrides it.

steps: Review custom desktop launcher files located in the folder named in the plan.
Delete unwanted desktop launcher files using your file manager, or delete the app directory it launches.
cleanup.risk: Removes per-user custom application launchers from your desktop application menu.
